summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K on November 2, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the board's co-optation appointment of Dr. Mehdi Shahidi as Non-Executive Independent Director, effective the same day, replacing Dr. Paulo Fontoura, who resigned in July 2026 after joining Sanofi as Global Head of R&D. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock are disclosed; the change is a routine board succession rather than a forced departure. What to watch: governance continuity and pipeline oversight, not an event-driven arbitrage angle.
